intro to python.description: Learn the basics of Python programming and object-oriented concepts.
outcomes: Write and execute basic Python programs.
Understand and apply object-oriented programming concepts.
Develop problem-solving skills using Python.

sql for data analysis.description: Master SQL for querying and analyzing data in databases.

outcomes: Write SQL queries to extract and filter data.
Use SQL functions to analyze and summarize data.
Work with relational databases efficiently.

statistics fundamentals.description: Understand the core concepts of statistics for data analysis.

Understand probability distributions and sampling.
Perform basic inferential statistical analysis.

pandas for data analysis.description: Analyze and manipulate data efficiently using Pandas and Numpy.
outcomes: Manipulate and clean datasets using Pandas.
Perform numerical computations with NumPy.
Handle real-world datasets for analysis.

excel for business analytics.description: Leverage Excel for business analytics and data-driven decision making.

Analyze datasets with pivot tables and charts.

powerbi essentials.description: Build interactive dashboards and reports using PowerBI.

Create interactive dashboards and reports.

deep learning with tensorflow.description: Master deep learning techniques with TensorFlow.
